messages:
Maya Ortiz: Prospect (regulated fintech) sent back their vendor risk review. Main asks: breach notification timeline, can we sign a 72-hour notice, what evidence (CAIQ/SOC2), and how regulator notifications are handled?

Tom Becker: Short answer: we can target an initial customer notification within 72 hours of confirmed incident, but we can't promise an unconditional 72h from detection. Investigations or law enforcement holds can change timing.

Rina Sato: Suggested contractual wording: "Upon confirmation of a Security Incident materially affecting Customer Data, Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide Customer with an initial notification describing the nature and scope of the incident within seventy-two (72) hours of confirmation where reasonably practicable. Notification timing may be adjusted to accommodate forensic activities or law enforcement directives; Redwood will notify Customer if such constraints apply."

Contracts Bot: Add: initial notice will include severity, affected systems, preliminary impact, and a named point of contact.

Maya Ortiz: They also want proof of IR practices (runbooks, tabletop cadence) and an RCA timeline. What can we share?

IR Ops: Offer redacted runbook excerpt + CAIQ snapshot under NDA. Runbook excerpt (redacted):

"Detection/Triage (0-4h): verify and classify
Containment (4-24h): isolate & mitigate
Initial Notification (24-72h): prep notice, legal review
Remediation (72h+): fixes & validation
Postmortem (30-90d): RCA and follow-ups"

Tom Becker: RCA cadence note: preliminary findings within ~10 business days, draft RCA in ~30 days, final report may be 30-90 days depending on complexity.

Rina Sato: Channels: primary = designated customer security contact (email + phone) + account team. For Dedicated/Private we can also post customer advisories to the portal. We don't independently notify regulators on a customer's behalf unless contractually authorized; we will provide artifacts and reasonable cooperation for their filings.

Maya Ortiz: They demanded an unconditional 72h in the contract. Can we accept with Dedicated SLA add-on?

Contracts Bot: We can offer an operational SLA for Dedicated customers: 24x7 on-call POC and a Sev1 acknowledgement SLA (e.g., 1 hour). That, plus the qualified 72h clause, is the usual compromise.

Maya Ortiz: Great. I'll draft the response with the redacted CAIQ offer (NDA), runbook excerpt, proposed clause, and Dedicated SLA option. Please review before I send.

Tom Becker: Happy to review in 20.

Rina Sato: I'll check the IR phrasing for accuracy.

IR Ops: Templates and CAIQ samples linked: https://internal.redwood/security/ca iq-samples (access: security-sales).

Maya Ortiz: Thanks all :thumbsup:
